This state indicates that the data path for the specified lane is not active. The lane may be unused or intentionally disabled.

This state indicates that the data path is undergoing initialization procedures, preparing the lane for activation.
Data path is in de-initialization state.
This state indicates that the data path is being de-initialized, shutting down or resetting the lane from an active state.
Data path is activated.
This state indicates that the data path for the lane is fully active and operational.

This state indicates that the data path initialization process has completed successfully, but the lane may not yet be fully activated.

Per-lane threshold flag status.

Each dynamic property represents a lane. The property name follows the pattern [R|T]x[1-8] (e.g., Rx1, Tx4). The value is a single ThresholdFlag enum representing the highest-priority threshold violation active for that lane, following the priority order HighAlarm > LowAlarm > HighWarning > LowWarning. A null value indicates no threshold violation.

Each dynamic property represents a lane. The property name follows the pattern [R|T]x[1-8] (e.g., Rx1, Tx4). The value is a Decimal representing the measurement for that lane.

Each boolean in the array represents a supported host-side test pattern: Bit 0 = HostSideGeneratorSupportsPattern0, Bit 1 = HostSideGeneratorSupportsPattern1 … Bit 15 = HostSideGeneratorSupportsPattern15. A value of true indicates Supported, and false indicates Not Supported.

Each boolean in the array represents support for a specific test pattern on the host side. Bit 0 corresponds to HostSideGeneratorSupportsPattern0, Bit 1 to HostSideGeneratorSupportsPattern1, and so on up to Bit 15 for HostSideGeneratorSupportsPattern15. A value of true indicates Supported, and false indicates Not Supported.

Each boolean in the array represents a supported host-side test pattern: Bit 0 = MediaSideGeneratorSupportsPattern0, Bit 1 = MediaSideGeneratorSupportsPattern1 … Bit 15 = MediaSideGeneratorSupportsPattern15. A value of true indicates Supported, and false indicates Not Supported.

Each boolean in the array represents support for a specific test pattern on the media side. Bit 0 corresponds to MediaSideGeneratorSupportsPattern0, Bit 1 to MediaSideGeneratorSupportsPattern1, and so on up to Bit 15 for MediaSideGeneratorSupportsPattern15. A value of true indicates Supported, and false indicates Not Supported.
Represents the state of a specific host lane in the data path.

Each boolean in the array indicates the validity of an Rx lane: Bit 0 = OutputStatusRx1, Bit 1 = OutputStatusRx2, … Bit 7 = OutputStatusRx8. A value of true indicates Valid, and false indicates Invalid.

Each boolean in the array corresponds to a validity of an Rx lane: Bit 0 represents OutputStatusRx1, Bit 1 represents OutputStatusRx2, and so on up to Bit 7 for OutputStatusRx8. A value of true indicates Valid, and false indicates Invalid.
Each boolean in the array indicates Tx lane validity: Bit 0 = OutputStatusTx1, Bit 1 = OutputStatusTx2 … Bit 7 = OutputStatusTx8. A value of true indicates Valid, and false indicates Invalid.

Each boolean in the array corresponds to a validity of a Tx lane: Bit 0 represents OutputStatusTx1, Bit 1 represents OutputStatusTx2, and so on up to Bit 7 for OutputStatusTx8. A value of true indicates Valid, and false indicates Invalid.

Per-lane input optical power values in milliWatts.
Contains per-lane receive input optical power values. Dynamic properties are named Rx1 for SFP, Rx1-Rx4 for QSFP, or Rx1-Rx8 for QSFPDD. Each value is a Decimal in milliWatts.
Per-lane output optical power values in milliWatts.
Contains per-lane transmit output optical power values. Dynamic properties are named Tx1 for SFP, Tx1-Tx4 for QSFP, or Tx1-Tx8 for QSFPDD. Each value is a Decimal in milliWatts.
Per-lane bias current values in milliAmps.
Contains per-lane transmit bias current values. Dynamic properties are named Tx1 for SFP, Tx1-Tx4 for QSFP, or Tx1-Tx8 for QSFPDD. Each value is a Decimal in milliAmps.
Per-lane optical power threshold flag status.

Contains per-lane optical power threshold flag status. Dynamic properties are named Rx1/Tx1 for SFP, Rx1-Rx4/Tx1-Tx4 for QSFP, or Rx1-Rx8/Tx1-Tx8 for QSFPDD. Each value is a ThresholdFlag enum indicating the highest-priority threshold violation for that lane. A null value indicates no threshold violation.
Per-lane bias current threshold flag status.

Contains per-lane transmit bias current threshold flag status. Dynamic properties are named Tx1 for SFP, Tx1-Tx4 for QSFP, or Tx1-Tx8 for QSFPDD. Each value is a ThresholdFlag enum indicating the highest-priority threshold violation for that lane. A null value indicates no threshold violation.
Indicates the temperature alarm and warning flags.
Indicates the temperature alarm and warning flags. Each entry represents a threshold flag that is currently set on the transceiver.
Indicates the voltage (Vcc) alarm and warning flags.
Indicates the voltage alarm and warning flags. Each entry represents a threshold flag that is currently set on the transceiver.
